I am writing to express my strong interest in the Bioinformatics Scientist position at Element Biosciences. With a strong research background and over six years of experience in bioinformatics and computational biology, I have developed a solid foundation in interpreting single-cell and multiomic data, and developing bioinformatics pipelines.

My conceptual understanding of scientific methods, combined with technical proficiency in Python, R, Bash, and tools like DESeq2, and STAR, allows me to effectively manage and analyze large-scale datasets. I have experience working with cloud computing environments such as AWS, and a proven track record of communicating scientific findings through peer-reviewed publications. I excel at collaborating with wet-lab scientists and researchers to design experiments and interpret complex results.

I am particularly drawn to this role because of Element Biosciences' mission to empower the scientific community and advance its multiomics platform. I am adaptable, eager to generate publication-quality scientific insights, and dedicated to contributing to platform development and customer enablement.

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Bioinformatician/Genomics Researcher position with the Hawai Cooperative Studies Unit (HCSU) at the University of Hawai at Hilo in collaboration with USGS PIERC. With a PhD in Biochemistry and over six years of hands-on experience in bioinformatics, population genomics, and molecular biology, I am well prepared to advance genomic-based research for biocontrol and conservation across the Pacific Basin.

I have built and applied end-to-end bioinformatics pipelines for high-throughput sequencing data, including RNA-seq analysis, gene annotation, population demographic modeling, and next-generation library preparation, using tools such as GATK, STAR, DESeq2, among others, in high-performance computing environments. My track record of rigorous data management, computational documentation, and co-authorship of peer-reviewed publications aligns directly with the expectations to archive pipelines, author manuscripts, and comply with USGS Fundamental Science Practices.

I am excited to apply population genomics and synthetic biology approaches to invasive species suppression and native Hawaiian ecosystem conservation, and to collaborate with a multidisciplinary team across state, federal, and international partners.
